id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description: The specification used for retrieving data.

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

htmlTag.description: The HTML tag to render the text in.

wrapWithContainer.description: Whether or not to wrap the text in a container.

hideFeedback.description: Whether or not we hide the feedback options

staticValue.description: The value to render takes priority over dataValue.

secondaryHtmlTag.description: The html tag for the secondary text

secondaryClassName.description: The class name for the secondary html tag.

emptyStateText.description: The empty state text displayed in the first header when no data has been requested yet.

title: A component that allows for rendering basic text.
name: GenAiUiBasicTextComponentReact
